messages:
marcus: Quick one  product asked for a very small migration playbook for v1 -> v2 focusing on: concise steps, one-liner banners, and two SDK gotchas (Ruby param rename + model alias swap). Need it by EOD Wed.

jules: I can draft the playbook. Suggest structure: TL;DR, migration steps (auth, params, model aliasing), QA checklist, rollback notes. Keep the main page <500 words.

riya: i'll do the Ruby snippet. heads-up: `client.chat` param `model_id` renamed to `model` in v2; older examples break with ArgumentError.

ben: i'll add the model-alias note: legacy alias `redwood-embed-v1` -> new `redwood-embed-v2-compat`. need a short redirect table and a sample curl.

marcus: perfect. add an explicit section: "If you rely on pinned model ids, update alias map or pin to model revision."

riya: ruby snippet to add:```ruby
# Ruby v2 param fix
# old: client.chat(model_id: "gpt-lite", prompt: "...")
# new:
client.chat(model: "gpt-lite@rev1", prompt: "...")
```

ben: curl redirect example for docs router:```bash
curl -I "https://docs.redwood.ai/docs/v1/guides/xyz" -L
# should end up at /docs/v2/compat/guides/xyz?deprecated=v1
```

jules: will keep banner copy tiny: "Planned deprecation: v1 API. Migrate to v2 by 2026-05-15. Learn more: /docs/v2/migrate". I'll PR en + pt + de.

ops-bot: Created task OPS-4119: deploy staged redirects & banners to staging. ETA 2026-04-09. Assigned to ben.

marcus: add a QA checklist in the playbook: 1) smoke old links, 2) run SDK unit tests against compat page, 3) verify analytics tag `deprecated=v1` shows traffic.

ben: opened docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6122 (playbook + redirect examples).

riya: will open ruby-sdk PR linking #6122 with the param rename note and a unit test to catch ArgumentError regressions.

marcus: awesome. after PRs merge, ops will stage redirects and we'll monitor for 72h before full 301 flip. update thread when PRs merge. :white_check_mark:
